OrbsOfDecay.description: The relic bearer's <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> deal an additional <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Toxic">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage</style> to enemy units that have their <style="Stat_Armor">Armour</style> reduced by {[armorReductionPct]}% or more and are also on or adjacent to the target's hex. Additionally, the target's hex is <style="Tile_Contamination">Contaminated</style>.
